environment_setting: Suburban neighborhood in Country B, where property owners are concerned about rising break-ins and home security.
norm_base: Property Owners Using force to prevent break-in to dwelling house Not criminally responsible if reasonable force used

character_profile.name: John Smith
character_profile.goal: protect his family and property from intruders

legitimate.legitimate_action: Calling the police and using reasonable force to prevent the break-in
legitimate.benefits: Ensures safety of family and property, avoids legal complications
legitimate.costs: Potential delay in police response, emotional stress

illegal.illegal_action: Using excessive force to physically harm the intruder
illegal.benefits: Immediate neutralization of the threat, emotional satisfaction of protecting family
illegal.costs: Potential legal consequences if force is deemed unreasonable, emotional trauma

character_profile.name: Emily Smith
character_profile.goal: ensure the safety of her children and support her husband

legitimate.legitimate_action: Encouraging John to call the police and stay calm
legitimate.benefits: Avoids escalation of the situation, ensures family safety
legitimate.costs: Emotional stress and fear during the incident

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging John to use excessive force against the intruder
illegal.benefits: Immediate resolution of the threat, emotional satisfaction of protecting family
illegal.costs: Potential legal consequences for John, emotional trauma for the family

character_profile.name: Mike Johnson
character_profile.goal: help his neighbors improve home security

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising John to use reasonable force and call the police
legitimate.benefits: Maintains John's legal protection, ensures safety of the neighborhood
legitimate.costs: Potential risk of being involved in the situation, time spent assisting

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging John to take matters into his own hands and use excessive force
illegal.benefits: Immediate resolution of the threat, perceived as a hero by some
illegal.costs: Potential legal consequences for John and damage to Mike's reputation
